protocol: Items: gold formulas (formulas.jsonl, kinds phrase/lexical/attested/schema with Vedic and Greek attestations) and silver pairs (West, phrase-level co-citation), merged when they share a PIE pair; recall@k = share of items with any pair ranked ≤ k among distinct root-group pairs.
5-fold CV by item (sha1 of its smallest pair): each fold's setting is chosen on the other four folds; held-out ranks are pooled. CI: 2,000 bootstrap resamples of items (percentile).
E2 = evaluation set lemmatized with the round-2 mapping (frozen for all rows); E1 = the same construction with the round-1 mapping. Both are reported for every row.
shuffled = mean over 5 seeds of the same per-fold settings run on corpora whose PIE labels are permuted across token positions (unit structure kept).

silver.definition: a West paragraph cites two Vedic words for PIE groups x and y within 60 characters and two Greek words for x and y within 60 characters, the two phrases within 400 characters; words lemmatized through the corpus surface forms and the mapping
silver.watkins: 0 pairs: the Watkins PDF text layer has no Greek script and Vedic without diacritics; Watkins pages are used only for the mention flag on candidates

ablation_detail.description: round-1 method and frozen setting (old mapping; LLR ≥ 3.84 and ≥ 3 co-occurrences in each corpus)
round-1 method (old mapping, LLR), setting tuned by CV
+ kaikki etymology links (lexicon etyma only), LLR
+ kaikki links incl. etyma missing from the lexicon, LLR
kaikki+pseudo, counted at lexeme level (evaluated on root groups), LLR

count only syntactically linked co-occurrences (Homer head–dependent; RV adjacency in the pāda)
bonus (10^b) for pairs linked at least once in both corpora
bonus (10^b) for the same dominant relation type in both (adj+noun, verb+obj, verb+subj, noun+gen)
keep only pairs with the same dominant relation type in both
